composition.serve_who: This sheet is a Danfoss PVG 32/16 hydraulic manifold ("AFT BLOCK B") providing 3 functions all explicitly labelled/legended for the STERN THRUSTER: STERN THRUSTER (main proportional drive, PVG32/EV-9.1), S.T. UP/DOWN (lift, PVG16/EV-9.2), and S.T. LOCK (locking cylinder, PVG16/EV-9.3). All three slices share the same title-block heading and are grouped under a single legend block naming the stern thruster repeatedly, so per the class rule they all serve equipment 461-stern-thruster-oms-h250. The manifold body itself (P/T/M/LS/LS_A/LS_B rails, inlet section, common relief/limiter cartridges on the shared rail) is shared block infrastructure and is attached to the block node 570-danfoss-pvg-32-16-aft-blockb rather than to the thruster.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: All three function slices on this sheet are labelled STERN THRUSTER, S.T. UP/DOWN, and S.T. LOCK, and the shared legend block ties EV-9.1/9.2/9.3 together under one heading naming the stern thruster. Per engineer-confirmed mapping and class rule, all slices sharing this label set attach to the stern thruster node.

functions.label: STERN THRUSTER (azimuth/pitch drive, EV-9.1)
functions.sheet_region: left third of sheet, ~x 0.33-0.47, PVG32 module column under 'STERN THRUSTER' heading
functions.what_it_does: Proportionally drives the stern thruster's main directional actuator toward STBD or PORT in proportion to a 0-10V command, using an open-center spool so oil flows freely to tank when no command is present.
key_components: PVEU proportional pilot actuator (main directional control, part 11166832)
Work-port relief cartridges A and B (part 157B2280 x2, protect A/B lines)
LS_A / LS_B pressure limiter cartridges (load-sense signal cap)
Inlet anti-cavitation check on P line

flow_scenarios.path: P enters module bottom, passes through open-center main spool 157B7123 directly to T return rail; A and B work ports are blocked from load; LS_A/LS_B see no pressure signal.

P → main spool shifted by PVEU pilot → A port → off-sheet to STBD-side thruster actuator; return oil from B port → spool → T rail; LS signal taken from A side, capped at 250 (assumed bar) by LS_A limiter cartridge.

P → main spool shifted opposite → B port → off-sheet to PORT-side thruster actuator; return oil from A port → spool → T rail; LS signal taken from B side, capped at 250 (assumed bar) by LS_B limiter cartridge.
If A-side load pressure exceeds 280 (assumed bar) relief setting, cartridge 157B2280 opens dumping A port oil to the common P/T rail, protecting the STBD actuator/hose.
If B-side load pressure exceeds 280 (assumed bar) relief setting, cartridge 157B2280 opens dumping B port oil to the common P/T rail, protecting the PORT actuator/hose.

functions.dry_data: PVG32 module, spool rated 65 lt/min, PVEU proportional actuation 0-10V (<5V=A/to STBD, >5V=B/to PORT), open-neutral center position, work-port reliefs 280 (assumed bar) x2, LS limiters 250 (assumed bar) x2

functions.label: S.T. UP/DOWN (lift function, EV-9.2)
functions.sheet_region: middle third of sheet, ~x 0.47-0.63, PVG16 module column under 'S.T. UP/DOWN' heading
functions.what_it_does: Raises or lowers the retractable stern thruster unit on solenoid ON/OFF command; a closed-center spool holds the thruster in position when no command is active.
key_components: PVG16 directional spool with PVEO solenoid pilot stage (part 11166838)
Work-port relief/anti-cavitation cartridges on A and B lines (settings not legible)

flow_scenarios.path: Closed-center spool blocks P from both A and B work ports; thruster lift stays locked in position, no flow to either port.
Solenoid pilot shifts spool: P → A port → thruster lift cylinder (raises unit); return flow from B port → spool → T return rail.
Solenoid pilot shifts spool opposite direction: P → B port → thruster lift cylinder (lowers unit); return flow from A port → spool → T return rail.
If pressure spike occurs on the active work line beyond the relief cartridge setting (value not legible), the cartridge on that port opens, dumping excess oil to the common T return rail.

functions.dry_data: PVG16 module, spool rated 5 lt/min, PVEO ON/OFF solenoid actuation, closed-neutral center position (UP=A / DOWN=B)

functions.label: S.T. LOCK (locking cylinder, EV-9.3)
functions.sheet_region: right third of sheet, ~x 0.63-0.8, PVG16 module column under 'S.T. LOCK' heading
functions.what_it_does: Engages or releases the mechanical lock securing the stern thruster in its lowered/deployed position, via ON/OFF solenoid command; closed-center neutral holds the lock state when not commanded.
key_components: PVG16 directional spool with PVEO solenoid pilot stage (shared part family 11166838 per legend)
Pilot-operated check/shuttle element on sensing branch (part 11105532)
Solenoid coil (marked '70', likely a coil parameter not a hydraulic setting)

flow_scenarios.path: Closed-center spool blocks flow to A and B ports; lock cylinder holds its current state (locked or unlocked) with no oil movement.
Solenoid pilot shifts spool: P → A port → lock cylinder (drives lock IN/engaged); return flow from B port → spool → T return rail (exact downstream routing beyond this crop not fully traceable).

Solenoid pilot shifts spool opposite direction: P → B port → lock cylinder (drives lock OUT/released); return flow from A port → spool → T return rail (exact downstream routing beyond this crop not fully traceable).

functions.dry_data: PVG16 module, spool rated 5 lt/min (per sheet legend for ON/OFF functions), PVEO ON/OFF solenoid actuation, closed-neutral center position (IN=A / OUT=B)

facts: Block designation: AFT BLOCK B, Danfoss PVG 32/16, 3 functions (STERN THRUSTER, S.T. UP/DOWN, S.T. LOCK), sheet 7 of 12, rev 10.
Shared rails along bottom of sheet: P (pressure inlet), T (tank return), M (measurement/gauge port), LS (load-sense main), LS_A and LS_B (load-sense A/B taps) — common to all three modules.

Common inlet/relief section at far left (near M/LS rails) contains a standalone PVEU 65 lt/min inlet valve assembly (part 11166832) with work-port reliefs, LS shuttle/check network, and an LS margin relief/limiter set at 300 (units illegible, assumed bar) — this is block inlet infrastructure feeding the STERN THRUSTER module, not a separate function.
Line identifiers along the shared rail: 157B5111, 157B6233, 11130982, 157B2014 label rail/bus segments between modules.
Multiple red warning-triangle markers appear at valve tops across EV-9.2 and EV-9.3 sections; meaning not confirmed at this resolution.
Revision 10 (16/04/2026) modification note for this sheet: 'PROPORTIONAL AFT WINCHES' — relevance to this specific block unclear, included for traceability.

Units and exact identity of the 300 setting on the inlet-section LS margin relief — assumed bar but unconfirmed.
Exact pressure/flow settings on EV-9.2 work-port relief cartridges (A and B sides) not legible.

Meaning of the number '70' near the EV-9.3 solenoid coil not confirmed — may be a coil electrical parameter rather than a hydraulic setting.
Role/identity of small valve block with red warning triangle at bottom-left of EV-9.1 crop not fully traceable.
Full downstream A/B port routing for EV-9.3 (S.T. LOCK) beyond the bottom crop edge not traceable — destination of ports unconfirmed.
Function of several small check/shuttle/parallel-bar symbols )( in EV-9.2 and EV-9.3 not confirmed.
